items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Eli Sarnees(?) (?) with the band once, and also Benny Carter.

ctx.x: No, no, it was regular legit theatre. Yeah. Then my brother, he came back home... No, before they left to go to New York. That's right. They used to rehearse at our house. And I used to put them down, because... And I think I was right, too -- although I didn't know I was right then. What they used to do, they'd... Well, they'd shake up the neighborhood, of course. It was a hell of a band. Eli Sarnees(?) (?) with the band once, and also Benny Carter. And they'd rehearse over a couple of numbers, and then they'd…
So that band went to New York?
